Name: Automate UI - Chests and Machines
Author: naveen000
Description:
[b][size=5]Warehouse Automation:[/size][/b]
Warehouse Automation automatically loads ingredients into your machines and collects finished products back into your chests. Just tag your chests and machines, and setup rules.
Your chests and machines can be anywhere—even in different sheds, barns, greenhouses, or cellars. No need to keep them next to each other!
You can also create rules through the UI to automatically transfer items between chests, sort your storage, and move items wherever you need them.

[line]
[b][size=4]Installation:[/size][/b]
1. Download the zip file.
2. Extract the contents directly into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Launch the game once to automatically generate the configuration file (config.json) where you can customize your hotkeys or use GMCM menu.
Languages Supported:
English - i18n/default.json
Chinese - i18n/zh.json
[u]Ask in comments for any language support.[/u]


[b][size=4]How to Use (Simple Example):[/size][/b]
Let's automate a Furnace to smelt Copper Bars.
[b]1. Tag your Chest:[/b] Hover over it, press [b]H[/b], and enter MyChest.
[b]2. Tag your Furnace:[/b] Hover over it, press [b]T[/b], and enter MyFurnace.
[b]3. Create a Rule:[/b] Press [b]U[/b] to open the dashboard, click [b]Add Rule[/b], and set:
[list]
[*][b]Group:[/b] Smelting[/*]
[*][b]Inputs:[/b] Copper Ore × 5, Coal × 1[/*]
[*][b]Input Chest: [/b]MyChest[/*]
[*][b]Machine: [/b]MyFurnace[/*]
[*][b]Output Chest: [/b]MyChest[/*]
[/list]Select items using the dropdowns and click [b]Save[/b].
[b]4. You're Done![/b] Put Copper Ore and Coal in your chest. The mod feeds the Furnace and returns the finished Copper Bars to the chest automatically.

[b][size=4]Chest Transfer Auto:[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47840/47840-1793074443-932267788.png[/img]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47840/47840-1793072737-649466771.png[/img]
Automatically sort items between chests, ship items, or send unmatched items to a fallback chest.
[list]
[*][b]Chest Transfer Tab[/b] – View and manage chest transfer rules.[/*]
[*][b]Add Transfer[/b] – Create a new transfer rule.[/*]
[*][b]Source Chest Tag[/b] - Select Source Chest.[/*]
[*][b]Item / Context Tag[/b] – Route specific items or categories like fruits, vegetables, and fish.[/*]
[*][b]Keep in Source[/b] – Set how many items to leave in the source chest; transfer only the excess.[/*]
[*][b]Destination Chest[/b] – Choose where items should go, with automatic overflow into other chests sharing the same tag.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Shipping[/b] – Send shippable items directly to the Shipping Bin while respecting global reserves.[/*]
[*][b]Quality Filters[/b] – Route Normal, Silver, Gold, and Iridium items separately.[/*]
[*][b]Multiple Routes[/b] – Create up to 10 routes per chest; rules run from top to bottom.[/*]
[*][b]Fallback Chest[/b] – Send unmatched items to a designated chest.[/*]
[/list][b]Example:[/b] Keep 10 Wood in your farmhouse chest, send excess Wood to wood_storage, ship Diamonds, route Fruits to keg_input, and send everything else to junk_drawer.


[b][size=4]Machine Rules:[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47840/47840-1793072736-5612122.png[/img]
[b]1. Live Search[/b] – Find rules instantly by searching for a machine or item name.
[b]2. Rule Groups[/b] – Organize rules into collapsible folders like Smelting, Crops, or Animal Products.
[b]3. Automation Route[/b] – See which items move from chests to machines and where finished products go.
[b]4. Live Status[/b] – Check progress and identify issues, such as missing ingredients, busy machines, or missing tags.
[b]5. Rule Actions[/b] – Enable/disable, duplicate, edit, or delete individual rules.
[b]6. Dashboard Buttons[/b] – Add new rules, clear all rules, manage item reserves, or close the menu.
7. [b]Earnings [/b]- See Earnings shown per rule for each year.


[b][size=4]Rule Page:[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47840/47840-1793072982-77193253.gif[/img]
[b]1. Group[/b] – Add your rule to an existing group or create a new one.
[b]2. Inputs Syntax[/b] – Automatically generates the rule syntax as you select items; advanced users can edit it manually.
[b]3. Item & Count[/b] – Select ingredients from searchable dropdowns and set quantities. Use [b]+ / −[/b] to add or remove ingredients.
[b]4. Quality Filters[/b] – Choose which item qualities (Normal, Silver, Gold, Iridium) the rule can use.
[b]5. Chest & Machine Tags[/b] – Specify input chests, machines, and output chests. Leave the input chest blank to search all farm chests.
[b]6. Overflow Controls[/b] – Set a backup chest and item limit to prevent your main output storage from filling up.
[b]7. Shipping Options[/b] – Ship finished products directly or send excess items to the Shipping Bin when the output limit is reached.
[b]8. Save / Cancel[/b] – Save your rule with validation warnings or discard changes.


[b][size=4]Reserve Menu:[/size][/b]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/47840/47840-1782029359-50648351.png[/img]
Protect your resources from being completely consumed by automation.
[b]Search Items[/b] – Find items instantly by name.
[b]Item Grid[/b] – Browse items in your inventory and farm chests.
[b]Item Preview[/b] – Confirm the selected item before setting a reserve.
[b]Set Reserve[/b] – Enter a quantity and click [b]Set[/b] to protect it.
[b]Active Reserves[/b] – View protected items and quantities. Click [b]X[/b] to remove a reserve.
[b]Close[/b] – Return to the main dashboard.

How Reserves Work
[b]Global Reserves[/b] – Protect a minimum quantity across your farm from automation and auto-shipping.
[b]Local Chest Reserves[/b] – Keep a specified quantity in a source chest while allowing excess items to be transferred.
[b]Chest Transfers[/b] – Move items between chests without removing them from your farm's total stock.
[b]Example:[/b] Set a global reserve of 50 Coal and a local reserve of 10 Coal in your workshop chest. Automation protects your overall supply while keeping Coal readily available in your workshop.

[b][size=4]Some Examples:[/size][/b]
Chain machines together to create fully automated production lines.
1. Smelting: Hardwood → Wood → Coal → Copper Bars
Setup: Tag one chest Chest1, a Wood Chipper Chipper1, a Charcoal Kiln Kiln1, and a Furnace Furnace1.
Create 3 rules:
[list]
[*]Wood Chipper: Hardwood × 1 → Chipper1[/*]
[*]Charcoal Kiln: Wood × 10 → Kiln1[/*]
[*]Furnace: Copper Ore × 5 + Coal × 1 → Furnace1[/*]
[/list]Set Chest1 as the input and output chest for all three rules.
[b]Result[/b]: Add Hardwood and Copper Ore to Chest1. The mod produces Wood, converts it into Coal, and smelts Copper Bars automatically.

2. Brewing: Honey → Mead → Aged Mead
Setup: Tag one chest Chest1, Bee Houses BeeGrid1, Kegs MeadKegs1 , and Casks AgingCasks1.
Create 3 rules:
[list]
[*]Bee Houses: Leave inputs empty; collect Honey into Chest1.[/*]
[*]Kegs: Wild Honey × 1 → Mead. Input/output: Chest1.[/*]
[*]Casks: Silver-quality Mead × 1 → Aged Mead. Input/output: Chest1.[/*]
[/list][b]Result[/b]: The mod collects Honey, brews Mead, and sends Silver-quality Mead to your Casks for aging. Finished products return to Chest1.


[b][size=4]MORE INFO:[/size][/b]
[b]Bulk Machine Tagging (Drag-to-Select):[/b]
Tag hundreds of machines in seconds instead of clicking one by one!
How to use -
[list=1]
[*]Hold T anywhere on your screen.[/*]
[*]Drag your mouse across your machines (green highlight boxes will appear).[/*]
[*]Release T a window pops up: “Tag 48 Kegs”.[/*]
[*]Type your tag and hit Save![/*]
[/list]Features & Safeguards -
[list]
[*]Quick Tap: Tapping T on a single machine still tags just that one machine.[/*]
[*]Safety Lock: Dragging over mixed machine types (e.g., Kegs + Furnaces) is automatically blocked to prevent mistakes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Advanced Features: Grouping, Reserves and Context Tags:[/b]
1. Rule Grouping
Organize rules into collapsible groups like Smelting, Artisan, Fishing, and Seed Making. Create groups in the Rule Editor or select existing ones; use + / − in the Warehouse menu to collapse or expand them.
2. Item Reserves
Protect resources by setting minimum quantities in the Reserves menu (U → Reserves). For example, reserve 50 Coal, and automation will only use the excess, keeping your crafting supplies safe.
